title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Breakfast Credit on Guest Folios and the Guest Services Credit Posting Tool
content:
At Ashbury brands that do not include breakfast for every guest, a stay credited to an Ashbury Rewards member whose tier entitles them to the elite breakfast benefit receives an elite breakfast credit on each breakfast line charged at the outlet during the stay, and when the outlet did not apply it guest services posts it later. The credit appears on the Guest Folio as its own line under the breakfast charge it offsets.

## The benefit in brief

| Element | What the benefit provides |
|---|---|
| Where | Ashbury brands at which breakfast is not included for every guest |
| Whose stay | A stay credited to an Ashbury Rewards member whose tier entitles them to the elite breakfast benefit |
| On which lines | Each breakfast line charged at the outlet during the stay |
| Who posts it | The outlet; when the outlet did not apply it, guest services posts it later |
| Effect on the bill | An elite breakfast credit line naming the breakfast charge, lowering the folio balance |

## Posting a missed credit: `post_breakfast_credit_af6b7bed`

**Capability.** Guest services posts the Ashbury Rewards elite breakfast credit that the breakfast outlet did not apply, against one breakfast charge on an open guest folio. One call books one elite breakfast credit line that names the breakfast charge it offsets, dated to that breakfast's morning, recorded as posted by guest services today with the reason that the elite benefit was not applied, and lowers the folio balance by the credited amount. The guest sees the credit printed under the breakfast charge on the bill.

**How it is invoked.** `post_breakfast_credit_af6b7bed` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, passing the four parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `folio_id` | The reference number of the guest folio of the stay, read from the folio lookup | Id |
| `loyalty_member_id` | The reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay, read from the folio or membership lookup | Id |
| `related_posting_id` | The reference number of the breakfast charge line being offset, read from the folio line lookup | Id |
| `credit_amount` | The credit to book | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; rounded half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `posting_id` (reference number of the new credit line), `folio_id`, `related_posting_id` (the breakfast charge offset), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the credit booked), `business_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the breakfast's morning), `balance_due` (USD to 2 decimal places, the folio balance after the credit) and `status`, which reads "posted" when the credit stands.

## Hypothetical illustration of a receipt

A call naming a folio, its credited membership, a breakfast charge from the morning of 12 October and a credit amount of 36.00 returns the new credit line's reference, the same folio and breakfast charge references, an amount of 36.00, a business date of 2026-10-12, the folio balance lowered by 36.00, and the status "posted". The figures are illustrative only.
